about: sand vanish (70fc0dd0): world sand resting on grass, and a plan that rewrites the grass under it to stone (tile-gravity's probe A, offline). TileCheck's dependents stage keeps a gravity block whose support is solid before and after (the fix); before it, every gravity block on a changed cell was cleared and the sand vanished. The lint models the dependents stage (S-GRAV, metric gravityKept); tile-gravity #2 keeps the vanilla no-falling-block half in game
